title: Every Photo in Our New House Had One Extra Person #shorts #horror
description: Four of us posed for the photo. Five faces came out. And every picture after that, she was closer. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Count the faces in your photos.

lines.text: We moved into the old farmhouse in October.
On the first night, we took a family photo.
Four of us smiled. Five faces came out.
A pale woman, standing right behind my daughter.
Dad laughed. Just a glitch, he said.
But in every photo after that, she was closer.
Last night, I scrolled to the newest one.
She was standing exactly where I held the camera.
We were all in the picture. So who took it?
